episodes.synopsis: Along with three others, Natsu wakes up with no idea what's happened. The four of them reach an island and try to figure out a way to survive.
episodes.title: Spring Begins

episodes.synopsis: Convinced that Botan has kidnapped them, Natsu and Arashi sneak out of camp and run into another survivor. Finally, Botan reveals what she knows.
episodes.title: Insects Awaken

episodes.synopsis: Natsu's clumsiness indirectly leads Team Summer B to the rest of their group. Her memories help them figure out their location, and their next moves.
episodes.title: Light Snow

episodes.synopsis: Arashi, Natsu and Semimaru stumble upon the Team Autumn settlement in the former Kobe region. They seem to be thriving, but their leaders are tyrants.
episodes.title: Autumn Begins

episodes.synopsis: In the ruins of Tokyo, Natsu, Arashi and Semimaru meet the sole survivor of Team Winter. Team Spring reaches Mt. Ogino Fuji and finds Natsu's message.
episodes.title: Heavy Snow

episodes.synopsis: Aramaki joins Team Spring, despite Fujiko's doubts. Hana decides to search for Arashi after hearing that Aramaki met someone who fits his description.
episodes.title: Grain Rain

episodes.synopsis: Hana and her companions discover a massive underground shelter. They find a survivor’s diary and learn the cruel fate of those who took refuge there.
episodes.title: Winter Solstice

episodes.synopsis: Hana's group and the Team Autumn survivors find the Spring settlement destroyed and abandoned. Momotaro wakes up among strangers.
episodes.title: Summer Solstice

episodes.synopsis: To survive, Hana and the others work together with Team Summer A. On the ship, Hotaru's cousin Hibari tells Natsu that Hotaru is slowly dying.
episodes.title: Lesser Heat

episodes.synopsis: Ango recalls his harsh upbringing in the program and the brutal graduation test that winnowed the survivors down to the final Team Summer A members.
episodes.title: Cold Dew

episodes.synopsis: Hana becomes convinced that Ango will kill her if she stays in the village. Natsu and the others make landfall near the former Autumn settlement.
episodes.title: Greater Heat

episodes.synopsis: Ryo orders Hana to join him in searching for a water source underground, putting her in a vulnerable position. In the caves, Ango recalls Shigeru.
episodes.title: End of Heat
